AC-01: validate protected requirement — When browser canvas context creation returns `null` for both `webgl2` and `webgl`, the web entrypoint selects `FallbackApp` without invoking `LoadSkiaWeb` or importing the Skia `App` first.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — If browser capability probing throws, startup selects the same functional reduced-graphics surface rather than leaving an uncaught boot failure.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — When either `webgl2` or `webgl` context creation succeeds, startup continues through the existing `LoadSkiaWeb` and Skia `App` path.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — A WebGL-capable browser whose `LoadSkiaWeb` initialization later fails still selects `FallbackApp` through the existing bounded initialization catch path.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Both normal and reduced-graphics applications continue to register through `WebAuthRoot`; the graphics decision cannot create, bypass, or alter an authenticated session.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — The WebGL-unavailable browser reaches the signed-in reduced-graphics workspace with no Skia canvases and retains ordinary conversation/build-plan behavior already provided by `FallbackApp`.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — The probe does not request GPU vendor/renderer details, persist capability state, send capability data to APIs, or introduce user-agent/browser-specific allowlists.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — No server API, Project, Work Specification, Engineering Run, source-lineage, validation, provider, deployment, promotion, or REVIEW authority changes.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Automated browser acceptance explicitly makes both WebGL context requests unavailable before page startup and proves reduced graphics renders without an uncaught Canvas/WebGL error while ordinary graphics acceptance remains green.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Exact-head client typecheck/state/export/browser/Skia acceptance, protected API/contracts, Bounded Autonomy, protected promotion, Workstream Spec Validation, and DSPy release compilation pass before merge.

critique: The web entrypoint performs one bounded, synchronous capability probe before `LoadSkiaWeb` and before importing the Skia `App`. The probe creates an ephemeral browser canvas and treats WebGL as available when either a `webgl2` or `webgl` context can be created. If neither context can be created, or capability probing throws, Parallax selects the already-existing `FallbackApp` reduced-graphics experience immediately.
